FAQ

Common questions

Everything you need to know before installing.

Does it work on Odoo.sh? +

Yes. Fully compatible with Odoo.sh hosting.

Does it require any configuration? +

No. Install and Incoming/Outgoing show up immediately.

What is the difference vs Pro? +

Free covers Incoming/Outgoing with search and record links. Pro adds color labels, starring, read receipts, threaded conversations and team permissions.
